traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Sarraceniaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; stipules absent; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems herbaceous; flowers usually solitary, sometimes in racemes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth usually sepals and petals, sometimes tepals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 5; stamens (10-) 50 to 100; carpels 3 to 5. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 394, family Sarraceniaceae: inflorescence posture nodding; read as "nodding".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 397, 398, family Sarraceniaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 394, family Sarraceniaceae: rhizome habit short_creeping (rhizomatous), usually; read as {"short_creeping": "usually"}.

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Sarraceniaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a rhizome. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
